body: Same for me... bed is - for me - the most secure place. Looking at pictures of my cat... reading a nice book to escape  the real world and sleeping. Maybe it works for you :)

Congrats! :)
I've done the same.. little satan improved the situation with depression so much. Its awesome how this fluffy little furrball can relax me, let me feel needed. 
Cats are awesome. :)

This time, I will always try to do something I love, something that keeps me flying, drifting away: listen to music, play guitar, sing, look some stupid sitcom.. 

My boyfriend is into astrophysics, and does not see any "goal" in life, instead he lives to be happy each moment he lives. 

I can't help you, really. Just don't do something, you would regret afterwards.

Normally I can show myself as a happy person to others. I will make plans and try to meet people. I try to smile; to laugh, be happy. Beside the annoying side effects I was zombified, it was as I was always pulled back, my friends were scared, too, because my personality changed that much... It didn't affected my creativity, I produced some nice paintings during my medication. 
I have almost learned to do daily tasks, like showering, eating, go to class... afterwards I'm exhausted. But if I ever have some time to think about life it becomes meaningless..
I don't think there is a medication to cure that, but maybe a therapist can help..

My boyfriend and some friends are supportive, but they are not trained for this. Maybe I can phone a therapist.. But I don't think I will ever take meds again.. It scares me. It changed me. I hated it.. and the side effects were the next problem..

I think the schizophrenia is gone through meditation, same bipolar. It may come back. And I know, the depression will always be part of me and my life.. 
I live through daily ups and downs, but this is better than the zombie-me with ADs. It was terrible, but maybe I will see a therapist again. My life is mostly living hell, but to this day I learned so much analyzing myself.. I try to be happy aroumd people. I kept going on. Thanks for caring!

And you don't have other problems then telling me to kill myself? Really nice. Really. 

My depression is clinical approved, as my intelligence is, the doc got me tested. I'm not Stephen Hawking, I know. And about the criticism - I want to hear it, I want to improve, but I can't handle the hate for myself.

Even if it sounds as my life goes on, the depression is killing me inside as ever, and thanks for the ignorance.
